fields.statement: QA with a scratch build (go build -trimpath -o $TMPDIR/rhiza-qa ./cmd/rhiza), fakes only (rex that backgrounds the tab command and pipes send to a fifo, a live claude that hooks Stop, says done and blocks on the fifo, a check failing once): rhiza run start --foreground on a workflow whose agent step waits for done (until_when=done) with a handback template. At hand-back the raw session record had no done mark, the message 0001.md pointer was typed (rex send + send-key enter), the second session done said 'is done' (not already), build visit 2 passed only after it, run succeeded. The same scenario on the merge-base build kept the done mark at hand-back. Two consecutive hand-backs (check failing twice) cleared the mark each time. Failure: the same step without a handback template failed the run with 'step build sets no handback template...', the raw record kept its done mark, no message file and no rex send. go test -trimpath -p 2 ./internal/api -run TestHandbackDeliver passed.
